responsibility: Provides the GNU/Hurd ELF subtarget configuration header for the RISC-V port. Its responsibility is to specialize driver-facing macros such as target OS preprocessor builtins, the ABI- and XLEN-specific dynamic linker path, linker emulation and shared/static `LINK_SPEC`, startfile search prefixes, icache flush helper naming, and ABI-based multilib selection, thereby adapting the generic RISC-V backend to GNU userland conventions distinct from the Linux, FreeBSD, RTEMS, and bare-metal headers.
